item.title: You can't trust macOS Privacy and Security settings
item.description:
📝 Open Privacy & Security settings, select Files & Folders, and confirm that Insent has been given access to Documents. Click on Open from folder and select your Documents folder there. Confirm that Documents access for Insent is still disabled in Files & Folders.
🔗 Read more: https://eclecticlight.co/2026/04/10/why-you-cant-trust-privacy-security/

item.title: France to ditch Windows for Linux to reduce reliance on US tech
item.description:
📝 France is trying to move on from Microsoft Windows. Amiel said that the French government can no longer accept that it doesn’t have control over its data and digital infrastructure. Topics cybersecurity, France, Government & Policy, linux, Security, Windows Zack Whittaker Security Editor Zack Whittaker is the security editor at TechCrunch.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/04/10/france-to-ditch-windows-for-linux-to-reduce-reliance-on-us-tech/

item.title: OpenAI backs Illinois bill that would limit when AI labs can be held liable
item.description:
📝 Until now, OpenAI has largely played defense, opposing bills that could have made AI labs liable for their technology’s harms. While SB 3444 is itself a state-level safety law, Niedermeyer argued that those can be effective if they “reinforce a path toward harmonization with federal systems. He notes that the lawmakers in Illinois have also submitted bills increasing liability on AI model developers.
🔗 Read more: https://www.wired.com/story/openai-backs-bill-exempt-ai-firms-model-harm-lawsuits/

item.title: "Negative" views of Broadcom driving VMware migrations, rival says
item.description:
📝 Since Broadcom acquired VMware in November 2023, numerous VMware users have sought to reduce or end their reliance on VMware technologies. Other companies, including Microsoft (Hyper-V) and Proxmox, have also been aggressively courting disgruntled VMware customers. Further, Broadcom has maintained a strong grip on the enterprise customers that VMware had pre-acquisition.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2026/04/nutanix-claims-it-has-poached-30000-vmware-customers/
